note: Optional ideas, deferred adoption, and watch-items. Nothing here is a minimum obligation. Preserved per contract even where adoption is unlikely.

leads.title: OME-Zarr labels as mask/derivative exchange
leads.evidence: NGFF 0.4 sections 3.6/3.7 define labels and image-label metadata incl. source image link (S11); QuPath reads and writes OME-Zarr since v0.6.0 (S09)
leads.why_deferred: one writer path beyond M3 table/overlay exports; needs U-2/U-3 groundwork
leads.impact_if_adopted: masks reopen in napari/QuPath/Fiji-family tools with coordinates intact

leads.title: Watch napari PR #9337 (non-orthogonal 2D slicing of transformed n-D images)
leads.evidence: open PR with detailed transform-chain description; author lists uncovered gaps incl. units (S04)
leads.why_deferred: oblique slicing is out of minimum scope; upstream still maturing
leads.impact_if_adopted: free oblique-plane review once merged and validated; our transform contract is compatible (4x4 affines)

leads.title: Automatic segmentation (InstanSeg-style) as later plugin
leads.evidence: QuPath 0.6.0 ships InstanSeg support (S09) showing integration pattern
leads.why_deferred: brief excludes from minimum scope; research tool must keep original-vs-derived distinction sharp
leads.impact_if_adopted: segmentation results enter as derived assets with op records only

leads.title: QuPath extension path as fallback architecture
leads.why_deferred: Java toolchain + license + foreign release cadence vs MVP needs
leads.impact_if_adopted: drop napari embedding; keep the same data contract on QuPath project files

leads.title: NGFF 0.5 tracking

leads.why_deferred: 0.4 is the widely interoperable version today; support boundary stays testable
leads.impact_if_adopted: upgrade adapters behind the corpus gate once the ecosystem settles
